notes.title: RUN THE WORDS v0.8.1 Changelog:
notes.notes:
IMPROVEMENTS/FIXES:
	• Increase player position loading speed
	• Misc. optimisations
	• Fixed screen scaling bug
	• Fixed book menu scrolling bug

notes.title: RUN THE WORDS v0.8.0 Changelog
notes.notes:
NEW FEATURES:
	• Mouse controls in game
	• Mouse controls in menus
	• Pause menu is a bookmark
	• Menu music
	• All transitions are page flips
	
IMPROVEMENTS/FIXES:
	• Greatly improved performance
	• Increased jumping heights
	• Improved checkpoints colliding with words
	• Other various bug fixes
	• Menu music on/off option

notes.title: RUN THE WORDS v0.7.5 Changelog
notes.notes:
NEW BOOKS:
	• Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen
	• The Wonderful Wizard of Oz by L. Frank Baum
	

NEW FEATURES:
	• Resizable window
	• Difficulty options of CHALLENGE or CHILL
	• Dynamic camera
	• Transitions are pages turning
	• Updated cover and splash screens
	• Improved shading
	• Sticky note styled instructions
	
	
IMPROVEMENTS/FIXES:
	• Fixed selection in chapter select menus
	• Book select sorted alphabetically
	• Increased player jump height

notes.title: RUN THE WORDS v0.7.0 Changelog
notes.notes:
NEW BOOK:
	• The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle by Sir Conan Arthur Doyle

NEW FEATURES:
	• Background textures are now pages
	
IMPROVEMENTS/FIXES:
	• Prevented player changing speed mid-air
	• Prevented player jumping up the wall of a word
	• Prevented player from being warped to the wrong-checkpoint when loading different chapters
	• Resets chapter progress back to the start after finishing a chapter
